import html # Predefined template for user profiles. PROFILE_FORMAT = """

{name}

{bio}

Status: {status}
""" def create_user_profile(user_name: str, biography: str, status: str) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML user profile from the provided data. Parameters ---------- user_name : str The user's full name. biography : str A multi-sentence biography provided by the user. status : str A brief, current status update from the user. Returns ------- str Sanitized and formatted HTML string ready for rendering on a web page. Raises ------ ValueError If any of the arguments is not a string or is empty after stripping. """ # Basic type checks for name, value in (("user_name", user_name), ("biography", biography), ("status", status)): if not isinstance(value, str): raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a string") # Trim whitespace and ensure non-empty user_name = user_name.strip() biography = biography.strip() status = status.strip() if not user_name or not biography or not status: raise ValueError("All fields must contain non-empty values") # Sanitize inputs to prevent XSS and ensure proper HTML structure safe_name = html.escape(user_name, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(biography, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status, quote=True) # Render the profile using the template return PROFILE_FORMAT.format(name=safe_name, bio=safe_bio, status=safe_status)
